svg.title: The prepared ECS adapter supplies an ordinary helper
svg.desc: During the first proposed movement phase, Fern has target 3, position 10 comma 10, and reserve 59 after maintenance. Meadow has stable ID 3, position 16 comma 13, and biomass 80. Separate creature and patch queries supply these values. Matching the ID yields a destination copy; the helper borrows Fern's position and energy mutably. After implementation the expected first step is position 11 comma 10 and reserve 57. The adapter is currently unscheduled and the helper is unfinished.

g.text: Where the helper's arguments come from
One ECS world · expected first movement phase, after upkeep
Creature is present; FoodTarget points to 3
Flint has no target, so this query skips him.
No Creature component; stable ID is 3
Borrow Fern's position and energy; copy the destination.
Use travel rate 2 energy units/cell and the world bounds.
Expected Fern: (11, 10), reserve 57. Meadow stays in place.
Reading the adapter does not activate it. The live helper is still your edit.
With<Creature> and Without<Creature> keep the Position accesses separate.
